SELECT 'STG_EDS_LNS_LADMDHISTORY', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_LNS_LADMDHISTORY WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LNS_LADMDHISTORY',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.LNS_LADMDHISTORY GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE


SELECT * FROM EDS.LNS_LADMDHISTORY
